title: Financial Contagion Networks as Annealing-Ready Ising Systems Cascades, Bailout Optimization, and Susceptibility
summary: Interconnected financial systems are vulnerable to cascading failures arising from cross-holdings and nonlinear contagion, making the analysis and mitigation of systemic risk a challenging computational problem. In this work, we develop a unified optimization framework for financial network analysis based on Ising models and Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO).
